# ggcircular

[![Lifecycle:
experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)

`ggcircular` is a `ggplot2` extension for circular, axial and
directional data. It provides rose diagrams, circular density estimates,
mean direction layers, circular scales, movement helpers and simulated
datasets for examples and teaching.

## Installation

``` r

devtools::install()
```

## Minimal example

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(ggcircular)

ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +
  geom_rose(bins = 16) +
  geom_circular_density() +
  geom_mean_direction() +
  scale_x_circular_compass() +
  coord_circular(zero = "north", direction = "clockwise") +
  theme_circular()
```

## Rose diagram

``` r

ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +
  geom_rose(bins = 16, aes(fill = after_stat(count))) +
  scale_x_circular_degrees() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_rose()
```

## Circular density

``` r

ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +
  geom_rose(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 24, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_circular_density(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_circular_degrees() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
```

## Mean direction

``` r

ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction, colour = season)) +
  geom_circular_density(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_mean_direction(length = "resultant") +
  scale_x_circular_degrees() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
```

## Movement data

``` r

ggplot(animal_steps, aes(x = turn_angle, fill = state)) +
  geom_rose(bins = 24) +
  geom_mean_direction() +
  facet_wrap(~ state) +
  scale_x_circular_radians() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
```

## Axial data

``` r

ggplot(axial_orientations, aes(x = orientation, fill = group)) +
  geom_rose(bins = 18, axial = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_mean_direction(axial = TRUE) +
  scale_x_circular_degrees(limits = c(0, pi)) +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
```

## Angular model diagnostics

``` r

if (requireNamespace("CircularRegression", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit <- CircularRegression::consensus(direction ~ speed, data = wind_directions)

  circular_model_diagnostics(fit)

  autoplot(fit, type = "residuals_density")
}
```

## Mixtures of von Mises distributions

``` r

fit_mix <- fit_vonmises_mixture(wind_directions$direction, k = 2)

ggplot(wind_directions, aes(x = direction)) +
  geom_rose(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 24, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_vonmises_mixture(fit = fit_mix, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_circular_degrees() +
  coord_circular() +
  theme_circular()
```

## Vignettes

Start with
[`vignette("ggcircular")`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/articles/ggcircular.md),
then see the specialized vignettes on rose diagrams, circular density,
mean direction, axial data, movement data and circular distributions,
model diagnostics, spherical helpers and posterior draws.

# Package index

## Rose diagrams

- [`geom_rose()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_rose.md)
  : Rose diagram layer
- [`stat_rose()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_rose.md)
  : Rose diagram statistic

## Circular density

- [`geom_circular_density()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_circular_density.md)
  : Circular density layer
- [`stat_circular_density()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_circular_density.md)
  : Circular density statistic

## Mean directions and summaries

- [`geom_mean_direction()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_mean_direction.md)
  : Mean direction layer
- [`stat_mean_direction()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_mean_direction.md)
  : Mean direction statistic
- [`circular_summary()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_summary.md)
  : Summarize circular data
- [`mean_direction()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/mean_direction.md)
  : Circular mean direction
- [`resultant_length()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/resultant_length.md)
  : Resultant length
- [`mean_resultant_length()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/mean_resultant_length.md)
  : Mean resultant length
- [`circular_variance()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_variance.md)
  : Circular variance
- [`circular_sd()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_sd.md)
  : Circular standard deviation
- [`estimate_kappa()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/estimate_kappa.md)
  : Estimate von Mises concentration

## Circular intervals

- [`geom_confidence_arc()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_confidence_arc.md)
  [`geom_circular_interval()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_confidence_arc.md)
  : Circular confidence arc

## Circular distributions

- [`stat_vonmises()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_vonmises.md)
  [`stat_wrapped_normal()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_vonmises.md)
  [`stat_uniform_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_vonmises.md)
  : Theoretical von Mises density
- [`stat_vonmises_fit()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_vonmises_fit.md)
  : Fitted von Mises density
- [`fit_vonmises_mixture()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/fit_vonmises_mixture.md)
  : Fit a mixture of von Mises distributions
- [`stat_vonmises_mixture()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_vonmises_mixture.md)
  : Von Mises mixture density layer

## Circular tests and intervals

- [`circular_mean_ci()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_mean_ci.md)
  : Confidence interval for a circular mean
- [`rayleigh_test()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/rayleigh_test.md)
  : Rayleigh test for circular uniformity
- [`watson_williams_test()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/watson_williams_test.md)
  : Watson-Williams test for equal circular means
- [`stat_circular_test()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/stat_circular_test.md)
  : Annotate circular tests

## Scales and coordinates

- [`coord_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/coord_circular.md)
  : Circular coordinate system
- [`scale_x_circular_radians()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/scale_x_circular_radians.md)
  [`scale_x_circular_degrees()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/scale_x_circular_radians.md)
  [`scale_x_circular_hours()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/scale_x_circular_radians.md)
  [`scale_x_circular_compass()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/scale_x_circular_radians.md)
  : Circular x scales

## Angle utilities

- [`normalize_angle()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/normalize_angle.md)
  : Normalize angles to a periodic interval
- [`angular_difference()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/angular_difference.md)
  : Signed angular difference
- [`angular_distance()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/angular_distance.md)
  : Circular angular distance
- [`deg_to_rad()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/deg_to_rad.md)
  : Convert degrees to radians
- [`rad_to_deg()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/rad_to_deg.md)
  : Convert radians to degrees
- [`hour_to_rad()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/hour_to_rad.md)
  : Convert hours to radians
- [`rad_to_hour()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/rad_to_hour.md)
  : Convert radians to hours
- [`compass_to_rad()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/compass_to_rad.md)
  : Convert compass labels to radians
- [`rad_to_compass()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/rad_to_compass.md)
  : Convert radians to compass labels
- [`is_angle()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/is_angle.md)
  : Test whether an object can represent angles
- [`check_angle()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/check_angle.md)
  : Check an angle vector

## Themes

- [`theme_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/theme_circular.md)

  [`theme_compass()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/theme_circular.md)
  : Circular plot themes

- [`geom_direction_arrow()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_direction_arrow.md)
  : Direction arrows
- [`geom_circular_point()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_circular_point.md)
  [`geom_circular_rug()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/geom_circular_point.md)
  : Circular point and rug helpers
- [`mutate_directional_features()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/mutate_directional_features.md)
  : Add directional movement features
- [`compute_step_length()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/compute_step_length.md)
  : Compute step lengths
- [`compute_bearing()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/compute_bearing.md)
  : Compute bearings
- [`compute_turn_angle()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/compute_turn_angle.md)
  : Compute turn angles
- [`as_step_data()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/as_step_data.md)
  : Coerce to step data
- [`augment_momentuHMM_angles()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/augment_momentuHMM_angles.md)
  : Augment momentuHMM fits with angular states
- [`plot_state_angles()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/plot_state_angles.md)
  : Plot angular distributions by state

## Angular model diagnostics

- [`circular_residuals()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_residuals.md)
  : Circular residuals for angular models
- [`circular_model_diagnostics()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/circular_model_diagnostics.md)
  : Circular model diagnostics
- [`augment_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/augment_circular.md)
  [`tidy_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/augment_circular.md)
  [`glance_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/augment_circular.md)
  : Circular model helper generics

## Spherical and posterior helpers

- [`spherical_to_cartesian()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/spherical_to_cartesian.md)
  : Convert spherical coordinates to Cartesian coordinates
- [`cartesian_to_spherical()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/cartesian_to_spherical.md)
  : Convert Cartesian coordinates to spherical coordinates
- [`spherical_summary()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/spherical_summary.md)
  : Summarize spherical directions
- [`as_circular_draws()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/as_circular_draws.md)
  : Convert posterior draws to circular draws
- [`summarise_circular_draws()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/summarise_circular_draws.md)
  : Summarize circular posterior draws
- [`autoplot_circular_draws()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/autoplot_circular_draws.md)
  : Autoplot circular posterior draws

## Autoplot

- [`autoplot_circular()`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/autoplot_circular.md)
  : Autoplot circular data

## Datasets

- [`wind_directions`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/wind_directions.md)
  : Simulated wind directions
- [`animal_steps`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/animal_steps.md)
  : Simulated animal movement steps
- [`hourly_activity`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/hourly_activity.md)
  : Simulated hourly activity
- [`axial_orientations`](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/ggcircular/reference/axial_orientations.md)
  : Simulated axial orientations
